nodes.label: .`GET farm lists every miniboss, the chapter boss and ten wins left once the campaign is completed`()
.`GET farm lists only the minibosses already passed in the middle of the campaign`()
.`a miniboss farm win answers the dropped card when the roll hits`()
.`a farm win answers a null drop when the roll misses and leaves the campaign untouched`()
.`a chapter boss farm win drops the next chapter hero and uses one of the ten daily wins`()
.`a failed farm fight answers 200 with no drop and keeps the wins`()
.`an eleventh chapter boss win in a UTC day answers 409 DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED`()
.`a boss not beaten yet answers 409 BOSS_NOT_AVAILABLE`()
.`a second farm win right after the first answers 409 FARM_TOO_FAST`()
.`a farmed chapter boss win returns the equipment drop and stores the piece`()
.`a farmed miniboss win drops a piece below 25 percent and none at 25 percent`()
.`a failed farm fight and a refused win drop no piece`()
.`a farm win pays no talent points`()
